# Edge Solution Global

> Edge Solution Global is a digital marketing agency based in Lahore, Pakistan, founded in 2020 by Zafar Habib. It helps small and growing businesses — real estate agencies, restaurants, solar companies, travel agencies and professional service firms — get more leads and build a credible online presence through social media marketing, paid ads, SEO, websites, branding and lead automation.

## Company

- Name: Edge Solution Global
- Founded: 2020
- Founder / CEO: Zafar Habib
- Location: Lalazar Commercial Market, Raiwind Rd, Thokar Niaz Baig, Lahore, Pakistan
- Service area: Lahore, Pakistan, and international clients (remote)
- Contact: info@edgesolutionglobal.com | +92 323 786 4800
- Website: https://edgesolutionglobal.com/

## Services

- Performance Marketing (Facebook, Instagram & Google Ads)
- Social Media Marketing
- SEO & Growth
- Website Development
- Branding & Design
- Lead Generation & Automation
